business_summary.text: Jio Financial Services is a listed core investment company holding a full-stack financial services group: NBFC lending (Jio Credit), payments bank, payment aggregator, insurance broking, and JVs with BlackRock (AMC, wealth, broking) and Allianz (reinsurance, general and life insurance).

operating_notes.text: Promoter group holding rose from 47.12% to 49.13% after converting 25 Cr of the 50 Cr warrants allotted in September 2025.
Executed binding agreement with Allianz Europe B.V. for a 50:50 general and health insurance joint venture in India.
Invested ₹300 Cr in wholly owned subsidiary Jio Finance Platform and Service Limited, bringing total investment to ₹335 Cr.
Jio Allianz General Insurance Limited incorporated with Allianz Europe B.V.; JFS to hold 50% via 49,50,000 shares for ₹4.95 Cr, subject to regulatory approvals.
Jio Credit average cost of borrowing 7.07%; capital adequacy ratio 22.35%; ₹1,500 Cr NCDs issued in June 2026 with a board-approved ₹15,000 Cr limit for FY27.
Jio Credit AUM mix: mortgages 44.2%, loan against securities (retail) 10.4%, corporates and SMEs the balance; mortgage average ticket ₹1.3 Cr, tenor 15.7 years.
Allianz Jio Reinsurance wrote ₹266 Cr gross written premium in its first quarter of operations; JioBlackRock AMC closing AUM ₹18,412 Cr.

timeline.summary: On 21 April 2026 Jio Financial allotted 25 Cr equity shares at ₹316.50 to Sikka Ports & Terminals and Jamnagar Utilities & Power on conversion of half the 50 Cr warrants issued in September 2025, lifting promoter group holding from 47.12% to 49.13%.
On April 22, 2026, Jio Financial Services signed a binding agreement with Allianz Europe B.V. to form a 50:50 general and health insurance joint venture.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,018.51 Cr, net profit ₹272.22 Cr.
On 6 May 2026, Jio Financial invested ₹300 Cr in its wholly owned subsidiary Jio Finance Platform and Service Limited.

On 13 May 2026 Jio Financial said it and Allianz Europe B.V. had incorporated Jio Allianz General Insurance Limited on May 12, 2026, with JFS subscribing 49,50,000 shares for ₹4.95 Cr for a 50% stake, subject to regulatory approvals.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,699.28 Cr (+73.2% YoY), net profit ₹340.44 Cr (-51.0% YoY).
Jio Financial Services released its Q2 FY27 earnings presentation highlighting consolidated revenue of ₹1,699 Cr and NBFC Gross AUM of ₹37,320 Cr.
